overview_description.description: Remind is a communication platform that helps every student succeed. Founded in 2011, Remind allows school and district administrators to reach and engage with their communities and connects educators and families with the tools that help them teach and learn. Investors include First Round Capital, GSV, Kleiner Perkins Caufield Byers, and Social Capital.

product.name: Remind Chat
product.description: A messaging platform that allows educators, students, and parents to send quick, simple messages to any device, ensuring communication even without internet access or a smartphone.

product.name: Remind Hub
product.description: A comprehensive communication tool for schools and districts that includes features like account and class creation through rostering, and administrative privileges for managing users and information.

product.name: Remind Tutoring
product.description: A service providing one-to-one, live tutoring sessions to help students advance their learning.
